name: pizza-store
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project pizza-store --web

options.command: next build && SERVER_JS=$(find .next/standalone -type f -path '*/apps/pizza-store/server.js' | head -n 1) && test -n "$SERVER_JS" || { echo 'pizza-store: standalone server.js not found after build'; exit 1; } && STANDALONE_APP_DIR=$(dirname "$SERVER_JS") && rm -rf "$STANDALONE_APP_DIR/.next/static" "$STANDALONE_APP_DIR/public" && mkdir -p "$STANDALONE_APP_DIR/.next" && cp -R .next/static "$STANDALONE_APP_DIR/.next/static" && cp -R public "$STANDALONE_APP_DIR/public"
